Home.aboutTitle: I create digital experiences where clarity, design, and execution come together.
Home.aboutIntro: I’m a Product Designer and Front-End Developer with over 5 years of experience turning ideas into scalable digital products. I work at the intersection of business, design, and engineering, helping teams shape product strategy, understand users, define clear experiences, and bring refined interfaces to life through front-end implementation. My work goes beyond visuals. I focus on building products that are user-centered, business-driven, technically feasible, and ready for real-world execution.
Home.processIntro: I work across strategy, design, and development — helping teams move from early ideas to refined digital products with clarity and care.
Home.skillsIntro: A thoughtful, human-centered process that turns complexity into clear, scalable digital products — from strategy and design to front-end implementation.
Home.features0shortDescription: I believe in honest work and building real connections.
Home.features0detail: Authenticity means staying true to my values, being transparent in my work, and building genuine relationships. I believe that real impact comes from honesty, openness, and a deep respect for the people I work with.

Home.features1detail: Growth is a continuous practice of learning, refining craft, and adapting with intention. I stay curious, welcome feedback, and turn challenges into clearer, stronger product decisions.
Home.features2shortDescription: I aim to create work that brings real value and positive change.
Home.features2detail: Impact means designing experiences that help people move with clarity and confidence. I focus on outcomes that serve users, support business goals, and hold up in real-world use.
Home.features3shortDescription: I value a sustainable rhythm where work and life support each other.
Home.features3detail: Balance keeps creativity and craft sustainable. I work with focus and care, while protecting the space needed for clear thinking, thoughtful collaboration, and long-term quality.
Home.approach0description: I start by listening carefully — uncovering goals, constraints, and what truly matters.

items.booking: Ticket Search, Seat Selection & Booking Flow Design

ux.title: UX Design
ux.body: Analyzed user needs and designed booking scenarios and user journeys.

ui.title: UI Design
ui.body: Designed interfaces, components, and visual elements with a focus on simplicity and consistency.

wireframes.title: Wireframing & Prototyping
wireframes.body: Created page structures and interactive prototypes to refine the user experience.

interaction.title: Interaction Design
interaction.body: Designed component behaviors, animations, and visual feedback throughout the booking process.

development.title: Front-End Development
development.body: Implemented user interfaces, managed application state, and integrated multiple APIs.

responsive.title: Responsive Design
responsive.body: Optimized layouts and interactions for a seamless experience across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

tailwind.description: Builds a consistent, responsive UI with flexible styling across the entire booking process.
tailwind.detailsTitle: Why I Chose Tailwind CSS for This Project

development.title: Rapid UI Development
development.body: Leveraged Tailwind's utility-first approach and predefined classes to build user interfaces faster while minimizing the need for extensive custom CSS.

responsive.title: Responsive Design
responsive.body: Efficiently implemented flexible and responsive layouts across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices using Tailwind's responsive utilities and breakpoints.

consistency.title: Consistency & Maintainability
consistency.body: Maintained consistent colors, spacing, typography, and visual elements throughout the application, making the design system easier to scale, update, and maintain.

zod.description: Validates passenger forms and booking data for accuracy and security before payment.
zod.detailsTitle: Why I Chose Zod for This Project

forms.title: Client-Side Form Validation
forms.body: Implemented structured and consistent validation across multiple forms, particularly for travel searches, passenger information, and ticket booking processes.

rules.title: Custom Validation & Regular Expressions
rules.body: Easily defined custom validation rules and regular expressions to accurately validate user inputs while keeping the code clean, readable, and maintainable.

types.title: Lightweight & Type-Safe Architecture
types.body: Leveraged the newer, optimized version of Zod to reduce validation-related code overhead and take advantage of TypeScript type inference for improved data consistency and reliability.

dexie.description: Stores booking drafts and city suggestions locally for a smoother experience on slow connections.
dexie.detailsTitle: Why I Chose Dexie.js for This Project

history.title: Travel History
history.body: Stored users' previous travel dates and searches to provide faster, more relevant suggestions on future visits.

filters.title: Filter Persistence
filters.body: Preserved selected filters and user preferences to automatically restore them and deliver a more personalized booking experience.

storage.title: Local Data Storage
storage.body: Leveraged IndexedDB for fast, persistent browser-side data storage and retrieval, reducing unnecessary server requests.

zustand.description: Simplifies state management for passenger details, seat selection, and booking steps.
zustand.detailsTitle: Why I Chose Zustand for This Project

state.title: Simple & Lightweight State Management
state.body: Used a lightweight and flexible state management solution to efficiently handle UI states across the application with minimal boilerplate and complexity.

booking.title: Booking Flow State Management
booking.body: Managed and shared essential booking data, including selected trips, seat selections, and passenger information, across multiple components and booking steps.

performance.title: Optimized Performance & Minimal Re-renders
performance.body: Leveraged selective state subscriptions to efficiently update components, minimize unnecessary re-renders, and maintain a smooth and responsive user experience.

lottie.description: Enhances user interactions with smooth animations, intuitive feedback, and engaging visual guidance.
lottie.detailsTitle: Why I Chose LottieFiles for This Project

animations.title: Interactive Animations
animations.body: Used lightweight, interactive animations to enhance the website's visual appeal and create a more dynamic user experience.

onboarding.title: User Onboarding & Tour
onboarding.body: Implemented animated visual guides and interactive tours to help users quickly understand the platform's features and booking process.

forms.title: Form Interaction & Engagement
forms.body: Integrated interactive animations into forms to make them more engaging, provide visual feedback, and create a smoother user experience.

tanstack.description: Smart caching of travel data, filters, and seat availability for faster performance and fewer API requests.
tanstack.detailsTitle: Why I Chose TanStack Query for This Project

apis.title: Multiple API Management
apis.body: Simplified fetching and managing data from multiple APIs, including buses, flights, and other travel services, through a structured and maintainable approach.

caching.title: Client-Side Caching
caching.body: Leveraged intelligent client-side caching to reduce redundant API requests, improve performance, and deliver a faster user experience.

filtering.title: Optimized Data Management & Filtering
filtering.body: Utilized features such as Query Keys and efficient request state management to streamline data updates and filtering, offering more advanced capabilities than using Axios alone.

bilit4u.title: Designing a Clearer Booking Experience
bilit4u.description: A booking and ticketing platform for searching, comparing, and purchasing tickets with less friction. I led UX/UI, interaction design, and front-end work to turn a complex reservation flow into a clear, polished experience.

seats.title: Interactive Seat Selection

results.title: Real-Time Ticket Results

hierarchy.title: Responsive Information Hierarchy
hierarchy.description: Organizing a dense booking experience while keeping filters, dates, ticket information and actions visually easy to scan.
